space_notes: Powered cleaver frame: +Z blade tip, +Y spine/up, +X right face; emitter block straddles z=0, grip runs -0.260..-0.045 with grip midpoint at z=-0.1525.

mount_hand_r_local.derivation: Live vibrosword_3103 weld quaternion retained for the identical +Z blade / +Y spine family frame. Position re-solved so this weapon's grip midpoint (z=-0.1525) occupies the same hand_r-local point as the live grip midpoint (z=-0.13): p_new = p_live + R(q)@(0,0,0.0225).

stow_socket.derivation: The ACCEPTED live carry, written down. This file previously carried the rifle contract's [0.16,0,-0.14]/[85,-45,0] as a placeholder, which disagreed with what actually shipped: SwordRig ignored the file entirely and used config.pawnPack.swordStow. These values ARE that config block (solved 2026-07-08 against the live skeleton: guard just behind/above the right shoulder blade, blade raking down the back, flat against the back plane), so promoting them to the authored socket is pose-identical to the accepted build and simply makes the legacy benchmark explicit and per-model tunable.

provenance: Source-authored powered cleaver redesign derived from the F4 lane; deterministic rebuild via build_vibrosword_powered.py.
